entries.title: Every GitHub sign-in is in Integrations, none in Projects
entries.body: Settings → Projects no longer has a sign-ins section. The GitHub sign-in each of your other computers uses for its own clones and pushes is now a row in Settings → Integrations, under your own connections, with its Sign in, its code and Sign out in its menu. The card that asks a computer to sign in to GitHub opens Integrations with that sign-in started.

picture.alt: Settings, Integrations, the GitHub connection signed in as octo, and under it a second GitHub row signed in as octo for Running as Builder, which clones and pushes its own work
